translation:
In all cases of stagnant blood within, with the stool not passing, use rhubarb (大黃) and mirabilite (朴硝). If the blood congeals and does not move, one must use two or three qian of saussurea (木香) and cinnamon bark (肉桂), mixed with hot wine and poured in; when the blood moves, one is saved. In weak and timid persons, when using mirabilite (硝) and rhubarb (黃), one must add saussurea (木香) and cinnamon bark (肉桂) and decoct them together; this is borrowing their heat to move its cold. <ins>Flower Stone Powder (花蕊石散)</ins>
Sulfur (石硫黃, four liang), flower stone (花蕊石, two liang)
Above, two ingredients, mix evenly; take one earthenware jar, put the medicine inside, seal the mouth, and externally surround and seal it all around with paper fiber and salt clay (紙筋鹽泥); when the clay dries, place it on a square brick, write the eight trigrams and five phases characters (八卦五行字), use ten jin of charcoal piled around it in a circle; from the hour of noon (午時), light the fire from below and gradually let it rise to the top, until after a night the charcoal is exhausted and the fire is cold; then let it stand another night; when the jar is cold, take it out, grind it fine, sift it through a silk sieve, and store it in a porcelain box. Take three qian per dose, mixed with boy's urine.
